Primary ask: Private VPC deployment in EU with SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning and RBAC enforced in Redwood Console/control plane. Security + compliance project with tight data residency requirements.

- Routing: regional EU-only routing, automatic fallback to dedicated capacity if private pool saturated.
- Data handling: no raw PHI stored outside VPC; ephemeral KV cache; detailed retention controls required.
